_comment: Template for the 500-episode full runs: the pilot rows for all 4 cells (names r3f_<p|g>_<sp|l10>_<short>), plus the
10x rows (AWM3 lib=big + grip_commit + term_guard) and two offline-motivated alternates. The coordinator picks the
rows to run (SELECTION: best borrowing + best non-borrowing per cell; 10x on the two pi0.5 cells first) and copies
them into a plain list for emit_arms.py. <RUN> = run root placeholder. Every kwargs set here has a PASSing harness
smoke on pi05_spatial_{inf,cache} + groot_l10_{inf,cache} and a PASSing G3 contract check (README.md).

a05_gr._why: release_guard gripper mode: grasp never delayed, only close->open needs |v|>=.6 twice + dwell 3 (the symmetric gc mode scored SR .10 vs .74 in the spatial pilot; gc rows above are the measured negative)

a1_gc_tgp._why: alternate: progress-only terminal gate (halves term_guard's offline late-third cost; the re-open clause rarely holds in spatial)

a1_gct06_tg._why: alternate: vote threshold .6 (fewer held transitions; offline neutral)

big._why: 10x reference (== AWM lib=big kref=5 up to step-0 exact ties; 47 / 94 MB pickles pi0.5)

prefit_note: taskset -c <cpus> env OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 .venv/bin/python -m exp.offline_search.closed_loop.plugin --os-method <method> --os-kwargs '<kwargs>' --os-cell <m>_<s>_cache --os-log-dir <RUN>/fits --os-fit-artifact <RUN>/fits/<name>.pkl ; measured: current 0.6-4.3 s, 21.9 / 26.0 MB (pi0.5 sp / l10), 22.8 / 28.1 MB (GR00T); 10x 2.8-11.5 s, 47.1 / 94.3 MB (pi0.5), 58.2 / 117.5 MB (GR00T); prior (borrowed) fits need ~1.3 GB RAM during fit (big-row features), the pickle is the same size as the current fit
